device.name: BMG microplate reader incubator and status (sidecar.bmg_interface.BmgCom)

facts.text: BmgCom's constructor calls pythoncom.CoInitialize, creates the BMG_ActiveX.BMGRemoteControl COM object and opens the connection with the control name; open_connection raises when OpenConnection returns a non-zero result
get_version returns the result of the COM GetVersion call; its docstring calls it the BMG instrument version
The module's __main__ block connects with the control name CLARIOstar and prints get_version() as the BMG LABTECH Remote Control Version
get_status and get_error return the COM GetInfo items 'Status' and 'Error' stripped, or the string 'unknown' when GetInfo returns something other than a string
plate_in sends PlateIn and plate_out sends PlateOut through _exec (docstrings: close and open the plate tray), and neither checks the response

set_temp documents 0.0 as off, 0.1 as monitor only, 25.0-45.0 for standard models and 10.0-60.0 for extended-temperature-range models; it raises ValueError unless the value is 0.0, 0.1 or inside the range the extended_temperature_range_model flag selects, sends the Temp command with str(temp) and raises when the ExecuteAndWait response is not 0

read_temps reads Temp1, Temp2 and Temp3 with GetInfo and divides each value by 10; its docstring gives the values in Celsius, or None per sensor when GetInfo returns no value (typical when the device has not been initialized in SMART Control or the sensor is not yet reporting), and a value float() cannot parse also gives None

run_assay sends Run with the assay name, the protocol database path, the output directory, the three plate ids, the output directory again and the output file name (str(int(time.time())) + '.txt' when none is given), raises when the response is not 0 and returns the output directory joined with the file name

The BmgCom class defines __init__, open_connection, close_connection, get_version, get_status, get_error, init, plate_in, plate_out, set_temp, read_temps, run_assay and _exec; init, plate_in, plate_out, set_temp and run_assay send their command through _exec, which calls ExecuteAndWait and returns its response, and the class has no stop, abort or pause method

The upstream sidecar keeps BmgCom on one worker thread: the thread calls pythoncom.CoInitialize, constructs BmgCom and runs every call it takes from a queue, and on shutdown it closes the connection and calls pythoncom.CoUninitialize
The sidecar README lists the endpoints /, /is_busy, /status, /error, /temps, /plate_out, /plate_in, /set_temp and /run_assay
The MADSci REST node labels Temp1, Temp2 and Temp3 as the bottom heating plate, the top heating plate and the optic slide heating plate
The upstream README says the BMG driver can only connect to the device when run with 32-bit Python on a Windows machine
The upstream README says the model name must be entered as 'CLARIOstar' when the device is instantiated, even for a BMG VANTAstar

safe_state.description: incubator heating off: the native set_temp(0.0) (Temp 0.0, the upstream's documented off value) acknowledged by an ExecuteAndWait response of 0; the temperatures are not driven down, and the plate tray and any assay started outside this package are not stopped
